thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: canary deployment text-encoder-v2 (eu-west-1) reporting multiple CrashLoopBackOffs and readiness failures. affected pods: encoder-v2-canary-*. Reason: initContainer 'mount-secrets' failed; admission webhook errors seen in kube-apiserver logs. HPA started scaling up aggressively. tagging @oncall-sre
ryan: acked, I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking rollout weight.
leen: I'm switching to oncall now — handing off. ryan, paste the top logs pls.
maria: seeing spike in embeddings error rate in telemetry (5xx) and latency tail at 99p up ~250ms. looks customer-facing.
ryan: logs: ```
initContainer mount-secrets failed: failed to sync secret 'encoder-token-eu': webhook "validate-inference.redwood.svc" denied request: field path: \"spec.volumes[3].secret.items[0].key\" not found
Back-off 5m0s restarting container
```
ryan: also noticed canary weight was bumped to 20% by the rollout controller, but admission webhook rejects cause pods to crash -> HPA reacted to readiness probes and spun up more replicas -> node pressure.
ops-bot: kube-apiserver: "admission webhook error: missing key 'token' in secret 'encoder-token-eu'" (x4 in last 2m)
jordan-prod: customer impact? which endpoints? priority?
maria: embeddings and text-generation embeddings route  -> ~8% 5xx in last 3m, ~210 customers with >1 error/min. no billing impact but latency and failed requests for some customers.
leen: quick mitigation checklist: 1) flip feature flag (encoder_v2) to off (kill-switch), 2) pause rollout / scale canary to 0, 3) revert rollout if needed, 4) patch admission webhook configmap or secret mapping, 5) coordinate customer notifications. anyone object?
ryan: doing step 1 now (LaunchDarkly API): `curl -X PATCH https://ld.api/flags/encoder_v2 --data '{"on":false}'` -> response 200 OK :thumbsup:
ops-bot: feature flag change propagated to eu-west-1 edge nodes (TTL 45s).
leen: step 2: patch deployment to scale canary to 0 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy text-encoder-v2-canary -n inference --replicas=0`
ryan: scaled to 0. canary pods terminating.
maria: error rate dropping already to ~3% in last 30s. latency tail improving.
jordan-prod: good. preparing short note for affected customers and support playbook. i'll draft and share.
leen: step 3: we should also undo the rollout on the main deployment to be safe: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/text-encoder -n inference` — do we want to do that or wait?
ryan: agree to avoid further risk. running undo now.
ops-bot: rollout undo started: observed replicaset rollback to rs/text-encoder-58b2d, image text-encoder:v1.12.
ryan: undo completed, new pods becoming Ready.
maria: telemetry shows 5xx back to baseline ~0.6% and 99p latency back near normal. customer-facing impact largely mitigated.
leen: root cause hypothesis: admission webhook configmap expects secret key named 'token' but the new secret created by CI used 'auth' key. mismatch allowed in staging but failed in eu-west due to webhook strict validation. combined with an accidental canary weight bump -> increases failure surface and HPA reacted to failing readiness probe.
jordan-prod: assigning action items: (1) ops to patch webhook to accept both keys or validate CI secret naming (ryan, ops), (2) infra to add gating to rollout controller to not increase weight during webhook failure (leen, infra), (3) product to notify top 20 customers & support playbook (jordan-prod, maria).
ryan: creating short incident ticket with links to logs and commands I ran. ticket: INC-2026-8473.
leen: good. also toggle HPA minReplicas back to safe baseline and add temporary manual cap to prevent autoscale storm. `kubectl patch hpa text-encoder -n inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2,"maxReplicas":10}}'`
ops-bot: HPA patched, minReplicas=2, maxReplicas=10.
maria: can we get a quick postmortem slot tomorrow? need to capture timeline and add automated test verifying secret key names on webhook acceptance.
leen: yes, schedule 09:30 UTC postmortem. ryan can you attach playback steps and logs to INC-2026-8473?
ryan: done. attached kube-apiserver logs, pod logs, rollout history, and LD change audit.
jordan-prod: support note drafted, will send to top customers with incident summary and mitigation steps. ping me if anyone needs to add details.
leen: thanks all. closing thread when postmortem scheduled and runbook updates merged. :white_check_mark:
